paragraphs.text: Iquatana is a plane featured in Planechase , on the card The Aether Flues .

Iquatana is a world whose atmosphere is almost pure aether . The aether has a strange effect on the ecosystem here; creatures tend to warp and vacillate, turning into other organisms. The world's land is an expanse of chimneys and sinkholes that vent the plasma-like aether, supporting vapor currents ridden by the dreamlike, fickle-formed creatures. Some planeswalkers visit here to attempt massive summonings, or to study the intelligent Iquati, who created the many Narcomoeba that float above the flues.

The plane's inhabitants, the Iquati, created Narcomoebas, beings of pure memory, as vessels for storing future memories as a replacement for their lost genealogical memory sundered in some unknown past event.
